scope: representation of a measured numeric result after its typed operation; not restricted to floor
preserve: working value, dimensional type and semantic context
canChange: display unit scale and its corresponding displayed numeric coefficient
explicitConversionTarget: existing explicit target-unit choice has precedence over automatic choice; no automatic rescaling away from a requested target
displayPipeline: typed calculation and applicable reference-number operations
explicit target or automatic unit-scale choice
format the coefficient in that unit under the existing decimal and approximate-zero rules
group identical displayed answers under existing rules
copy: existing rule: displayed numeric coefficient only for an ordinary measured quantity; shown 1m copies 1, not an earlier input-scale coefficient
lazyAlternatives: retain typed alternatives and choose display for each before grouping; do not change unit inference merely to obtain a convenient scale
history: existing immutable working values and displayed answers remain authoritative; copying history does not recalculate or rerun a new live scale decision
locale: existing Latin/local unit notation and explicit target-spelling rules remain applicable
unresolved: Automatic candidate scale ladders, coefficient thresholds and boundary/zero behavior.
Display-family choice for metric/nonmetric mixtures and information-unit prefix families.
Fixed-duration and derived-unit result scales, including denominators.
